content.short: Pundi X brings crypto payments to retail stores and is building tokenized stock baskets.
content.description: Pundi X is known for its XPOS point-of-sale devices that let retail stores accept crypto payments, and is now building AI-assisted tools for tokenizing investment ideas as tradeable stock baskets. Stable's official ecosystem page lists Pundi X.
content.meta: Pundi X enables retail crypto payments and tokenized stock baskets, listed in Stable's ecosystem.
